title: Modeling nonstationary spatial processes with normalizing flows
abstract: arXiv:2509.12884v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Nonstationary spatial processes can often be represented as stationary processes on a warped spatial domain. Selecting an appropriate spatial warping function for a given application is often difficult and, as a result of this, warping methods have largely been limited to two-dimensional spatial domains. In this paper, we introduce a novel approach to modeling nonstationary, anisotropic spatial processes using neural autoregressive flows (NAFs), a class of invertible mappings capable of generating complex, high-dimensional warpings. Through simulation studies we demonstrate that a NAF-based model has greater representational capacity than other commonly used spatial process models. We apply our proposed modeling framework to a subset of the 3D Argo Floats dataset, highlighting the utility of our framework in real-world applications.

translated_title: 基于归一化流的非平稳空间过程建模
translated_abstract: 非平稳空间过程通常可以表示为在扭曲空间域上的平稳过程。然而，为给定应用选择合适的空间扭曲函数往往十分困难，因此扭曲方法在很大程度上仅局限于二维空间域。本文提出了一种使用神经自回归流（NAFs）建模非平稳、各向异性空间过程的新方法，NAFs是一类能够生成复杂高维扭曲的可逆映射。通过模拟研究，我们证明了基于NAF的模型比其他常用的空间过程模型具有更强的表示能力。我们将所提出的建模框架应用于三维Argo浮标数据集的一个子集，凸显了该框架在实际应用中的实用性。
tldr: 本文提出利用神经自回归流（NAFs）构建可逆的高维空间扭曲映射，从而灵活建模非平稳、各向异性的空间过程，并在三维Argo浮标数据上验证了其优于现有模型的表示能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces neural autoregressive flows (NAFs) as invertible spatial warpings to model nonstationary, anisotropic spatial processes, demonstrating greater representational capacity than existing methods and applying the framework to 3D Argo Floats data.
